devdoc.details: Upgradeable, pausable, reentrancy-guarded. BoardOfDirectors is resolved via Officer.

EnforcedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is paused.

ExpectedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is not paused.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

Proposals__BoardOfDirectorAddressNotSet(.details: The BoardOfDirectors address has not been configured.

Proposals__BoardOfDirectorsNotFound().details: The BoardOfDirectors contract could not be located via the Officer.

Proposals__NoBoardMembers().details: The board of directors is empty.

Proposals__NotAllowed().details: The caller is not allowed to perform this action.

Proposals__OfficerAddressNotSet().details: The officer contract address has not been configured.

Proposals__OnlyBoardMember().details: The caller is not a member of the board of directors.

Proposals__ProposalAlreadyVoted().details: The caller has already voted on this proposal.

Proposals__ProposalNotFound().details: The proposal id does not exist.

Proposals__ProposalVotingEnded().details: Voting has ended for this proposal.

Proposals__ProposalVotingNotStarted().details: Voting has not yet started for this proposal.

Proposals__ZeroSender().details: The caller (msg.sender) was the zero address when initializing.

Initialized(uint64).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

params.creator: The address that created the proposal.
params.proposalId: The id of the new proposal.
params.title: The proposal title.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

castVote(uint256,uint8).details: Casts a vote for a proposal.

params.proposalId: The ID of the proposal to vote on.

params.endDate: The end date of the proposal (in Unix timestamp).
params.proposalType: The category of the proposal (e.g. "Budget", "Policy Change").
params.startDate: The start date of the proposal (in Unix timestamp).
params.title: The title of the proposal.

getProposal(uint256).details: Retrieves information about a specific proposal.

params.proposalId: The ID of the proposal to retrieve.

returns._0: True if the voter has voted.

params.ownerAddress: Address that will own the contract.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

tallyResults(uint256).details: Tally the results of a proposal after voting has ended.

params.proposalId: The ID of the proposal to tally.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

__gap.details: Storage gap reserving 50 slots for future upgrades. Decrement when adding      new state variables above so the reserve stays constant and proxy slots don't shift.

s_nextProposalId.details: Id assigned to the next proposal.

s_officerAddress.details: Address of the Officer contract used to locate BoardOfDirectors.

devdoc.title: Proposals

ProposalCreated(uint256,string,address,u.notice: Emitted when a proposal is created.

ProposalTallyResults(uint256,uint8,uint2.notice: Emitted when proposal results are tallied.

ProposalVoted(uint256,address,uint8,uint.notice: Emitted when a vote is cast on a proposal.

castVote(uint256,uint8).notice: Only members of the board of directors can vote on proposals.

createProposal(string,string,string,uint.notice: Creates a new proposal. Only members of the board of directors can create proposals.

getBoardOfDirectors().notice: Returns the current Board of Directors members.

getNextProposalId().notice: Returns the id that will be assigned to the next proposal.

getOfficerAddress().notice: Returns the address of the Officer contract used to locate BoardOfDirectors.

hasVoted(uint256,address).notice: Returns whether a voter has already voted on a proposal.

tallyResults(uint256).notice: This function is called automatically when all board members have voted.

userdoc.notice: Allows the Board of Directors to create proposals, vote on them,         and automatically calculate results.
